RESOLUTION.DESC:
The Security Council,
[i]Acknowledging[/i] the malevolent forces which attempted the destruction of [region]Empires Forever United[/region], hereafter referred to as EFU,
[i]Celebrating[/i] the efforts of defenders who passed SC#523 to ensure EFU would not fall into the control of Invaders,
[i]Noting[/i] that on the 13th of September 2026, EFU successfully transitioned into a stronghold after two years of insecurity as the region danced between native and foreign control,
[i]Recognizing[/i] that the remaining natives of EFU do not see their resolution as a source of pride but redundancy following the transition,
[i]Believing[/i] that the resolution has become obsolete and serves no functional purpose to the region in any meaningful capacity,
Hereby Repeals SC#523 "Liberate Empires Forever United".
RESOLUTION.NAME: Repeal "Liberate Empires Forever United"
